title: YouTube channel monetization policies (reused content; inauthentic content, formerly repetitious)
note: Reused content applies 'even if you have permission from the original creator'; renamed repetitious -> inauthentic on 2025-07-15 to cover repetitive or mass-produced content.

title: Disclosing use of altered or synthetic content
note: Disclose realistic content that makes a real person appear to say/do something, alters real events/places, or generates realistic scenes; captions, filters and cloning one's own voice for dubs don't need it.

title: Add paid product placements, sponsorships & endorsements
note: Creators tick the paid-promotion box in video details; creators and partners remain responsible for legal requirements.

title: Video chapters
note: First timestamp 00:00; at least three timestamps; each chapter at least 10 seconds.

title: Upload YouTube Shorts (length and aspect ratio)
note: Vertical or square videos up to three minutes uploaded after 2024-10-15 are Shorts.

title: Determining if your content is made for kids
note: Cites COPPA and YouTube's agreement with the US FTC.

title: YouTube Data API v3: Videos: insert
note: 1 unit in the Video Uploads quota bucket; accepted scopes include youtube.upload; uploads from unverified API projects created after 2020-07-28 are restricted to private; settable: status.privacyStatus, publishAt, selfDeclaredMadeForKids, containsSyntheticMedia (paidProductPlacementDetails is a readable part, not a settable property).

title: YouTube Data API v3: Videos resource
note: Title max 100 characters, description max 5000 bytes, neither may contain < or >; tags max 500 characters incl. commas; publishAt only when privacyStatus is private.

title: YouTube Data API v3: Videos: update
note: Requires youtube, youtube.force-ssl or youtubepartner scope (not youtube.upload); 50 units; paidProductPlacementDetails not among settable properties.

title: YouTube Data API: Quota calculator / determine quota cost
note: Default allocation: 100 search.list calls, 100 videos.insert calls, and 10,000 units per day for all other endpoints.

title: YouTube Data API: Revision history
note: 2024-10-30 containsSyntheticMedia added; 2025-12-04 upload cost cut from ~1600 to ~100 units; 2026-06-01 videos.insert and search.list moved to their own quota buckets.

title: YouTube API Services: Required Minimum Functionality
note: Upload clients must let users choose public, private or unlisted.

title: YouTube Data API: OAuth 2.0 for installed applications (scopes)
note: Lists youtube, youtube.force-ssl, youtube.readonly, youtube.upload and partner scopes.

title: YouTube Analytics and Reporting APIs: Metrics
note: averageViewDuration (s), averageViewPercentage, audienceWatchRatio, relativeRetentionPerformance definitions.

title: OAuth 2.0 for iOS & Desktop Apps
note: PKCE with S256 code challenge; loopback redirect http://127.0.0.1:port for desktop apps; state parameter.

title: Using OAuth 2.0 for Web Server Applications (token revocation, incremental authorization)
note: Revoke via POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke; request scopes incrementally, in context; store refresh tokens securely.

title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
note: Put the disclosure with the endorsement; in the video, not just the description; audio and video together is more noticeable; don't rely only on a platform's disclosure tool.

title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
note: Affiliate links need disclosure; 'affiliate link' alone is not adequate; example wording: 'I get commissions for purchases made through links in this post.'

title: Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising, 16 CFR Part 255
note: Section 255.5: material connections must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously; 255.0(f): a disclosure in both visual and audible portions is more likely clear and conspicuous.

title: 15 U.S.C. § 77q(b) (Securities Act of 1933 § 17(b), anti-touting)

author.literal: Legal Information Institute, Cornell Law School

note: Publicizing a security for consideration from an issuer, underwriter or dealer requires fully disclosing the receipt and the amount of that consideration.

title: Social Media and Stock Tip Scams (Investor Alert)

author.literal: US Securities and Exchange Commission, Office of Investor Education and Advocacy

note: Red flags: guaranteed high returns with little risk, pump-and-dump, scalping, touting without disclosing compensation.

title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications 2025
note: LLM01:2025 Prompt Injection; LLM05:2025 Improper Output Handling; LLM06:2025 Excessive Agency.

title: Turn on 2-Step Verification
note: Google Account > Security & sign-in > 'Turn on 2-Step Verification'; passkeys and hardware security keys are recommended because they resist phishing.

title: Configure the OAuth consent screen and choose scopes
note: Menu > Google Auth platform > Branding, then Audience (Internal/External, test users) and Data Access (scopes).

title: Using OAuth 2.0 to Access Google APIs (refresh token expiration)
note: External apps in 'Testing' publishing status get refresh tokens that expire in 7 days; limit of 100 refresh tokens per Google Account per OAuth client ID (oldest silently invalidated).

title: YouTube Data API v3: Videos: delete
note: Accepts youtubepartner, youtube or youtube.force-ssl scopes (not youtube.upload).

title: YouTube Data API v3: Channels: update
note: Accepts youtubepartner, youtube or youtube.force-ssl scopes (not youtube.upload).
